## Diagnostics

Open **Settings → reMarkable Tagged Sync → Report a problem**, press **Copy diagnostics**, and
paste the result here. It contains your plugin and Obsidian versions, your OS, whether Apple
Vision is available, and the last error. Nothing is sent anywhere by pressing the button.

```
paste here
```

## What happened

What did you do, and what did you expect instead?

## Error text

If you saw a message, paste it here. If the plugin told you to check the developer console, open
it with `Ctrl+Shift+I` (Windows/Linux) or `Cmd+Option+I` (macOS), look for lines starting with
`Tagged Sync:`, and paste them.

```
paste here
```

## Anything else

Screenshots, a sample note, or how often it happens — whatever you think helps.

Please do not paste the contents of private notes. A redacted example is fine.
